title: PrimeClans
description: Minecraft clans with support for add-ons and APIs
body:
### PrimeClans

Modern and lightweight clan plugin for Minecraft servers running newer versions.

PrimeClans allows players to create their own clans, invite friends, build communities, and progress together. The plugin focuses on performance, customization, and providing all essential clan features without unnecessary complexity.

## Features

* Create and manage clans
* Configurable clan creation cost using Vault economy
* Clan treasury system
* Clan storage
* Private clan chat
* Clan PvP toggle
* Clan member glow/highlight system powered by PacketEvents
* Fully customizable menus
* JavaScript scripting system for creating custom placeholders
* Multi-language support
* PlaceholderAPI support
* Add-on support
* Optimized for modern Minecraft versions

## Clan Progression

Players can create a clan using:

`/clan create <name>`

Server owners can configure the economy cost required to create a clan through Vault-supported economy plugins.

After creating a clan, players can invite friends, grow their community, earn experience, level up their clan, and unlock new opportunities together.

## Clan Glow System

PrimeClans includes a clan glow system powered by PacketEvents.

Clan members can easily identify their teammates through packet-based glowing effects without requiring scoreboards or other heavy solutions.

## Placeholder Scripting

PrimeClans includes a built-in JavaScript scripting system that allows server owners to create custom placeholders without modifying the plugin source code.

This makes it easy to integrate clan data into scoreboards, menus, holograms, chat formats, and other plugins.

## PlaceholderAPI Placeholders

Available placeholders:

* `%primeclans_name%` - Clan name
* `%primeclans_level%` - Current clan level
* `%primeclans_people%` - Number of clan members
* `%primeclans_balance%` - Clan treasury balance
* `%primeclans_exp%` - Current clan experience
* `%primeclans_exp_to_next%` - Experience required for the next clan level

## Language Support

Available languages:

* Russian (ru)
* Ukrainian (ua)
* Belarusian (by)
* English (en)
* Spanish (es)
* French (fr)
* German (de)

You can also create and use your own custom language files.

## Add-ons

PrimeClans supports external add-ons located in:

`plugins/PrimeClans/addons/`

Available add-ons:

1. ClanTopAddon - [download](https://github.com/Toxez/ClanTopAddon/releases)
2. ClanHomeAddon - [download](https://github.com/Toxez/ClanHomeAddon/releases)

## Dependencies

* VLibAPI - [download](https://github.com/Toxez/VLibAPI/releases)
* Vault
* PlaceholderAPI
* PacketEvents

## Commands

### Clan Management

* `/clan create [name]` - Create a clan
* `/clan accept [clan]` - Accept an invitation
* `/clan invite [player]` - Invite a player
* `/clan delete` - Delete a clan
* `/clan kick [player]` - Kick a player
* `/clan leave` - Leave the clan
* `/clan setleader [player]` - Transfer clan leadership

### Communication

* `/clan chat [message]` - Send a message to clan chat

### Economy

* `/clan balance` - View clan treasury balance
* `/clan invest [amount]` - Deposit money into the treasury
* `/clan withdraw [amount]` - Withdraw money from the treasury (leader only)

### Utilities

* `/clan menu` - Open clan menu
* `/clan info` - View clan information
* `/clan storage` - Open clan storage
* `/clan glow` - Toggle clan glow
* `/clan pvp` - Toggle clan PvP
